kurals.tr: Thakkaangu Naatith Thalaichchellaa Vannaththaal / Oththaangu Oruppadhu Vendhu
kurals.m: He is a king who having equitably examined (any injustice which has been brought to his notice), suitably punishes it, so that it may not be again committed

kurals.tr: Katidhochchi Mella Erika Netidhaakkam / Neengaamai Ventu Pavar
kurals.m: Let the king, who desires that his prosperity may long remain, commence his preliminary enquires with strictness, and then punish with mildness

kurals.tr: Veruvandha Seydhozhukum Vengola Naayin / Oruvandham Ollaik Ketum
kurals.m: The cruel-sceptred king, who acts so as to put his subjects in fear, will certainly and quickly come to ruin

kurals.tr: Iraikatiyan Endruraikkum Innaachchol Vendhan / Uraikatuki Ollaik Ketum
kurals.m: The king who is spoken of as cruel will quickly perish; his life becoming shortened

kurals.tr: Arunjevvi Innaa Mukaththaan Perunjelvam / Peeykan Tannadhu Utaiththu
kurals.m: The great wealth of him who is difficult of access and possesses a sternness of countenance, is like that which has been obtained by a devil

kurals.tr: Katunjollan Kannilan Aayin Netunjelvam / Neetindri Aange Ketum
kurals.m: The abundant wealth of the king whose words are harsh and whose looks are void of kindness, will instantly perish instead of abiding long, with him

kurals.tr: Katumozhiyum Kaiyikandha Thantamum Vendhan / Atumuran Theykkum Aram
kurals.m: Severe words and excessive punishments will be a file to waste away a king's power for destroying (his enemies)

kurals.tr: Inaththaatri Ennaadha Vendhan Sinaththaatrich / Cheerir Sirukum Thiru
kurals.m: The prosperity of that king will waste away, who without reflecting (on his affairs himself), commits them to his ministers, and (when a failure occurs) gives way to anger, and rages against them

kurals.tr: Seruvandha Pozhdhir Siraiseyyaa Vendhan / Veruvandhu Veydhu Ketum
kurals.m: The king who has not provided himself with a place of defence, will in times of war be seized with fear and quickly perish

kurals.tr: Kallaarp Pinikkum Katungol Adhuvalladhu / Illai Nilakkup Porai
kurals.m: The earth bears up no greater burden than ignorant men whom a cruel sceptre attaches to itself (as the ministers of its evil deeds)
